# MySpaFilter

> Independent hot tub / spa filter cross-reference. Look up a cartridge by OEM, Unicel, Pleatco or Filbur part number and get equivalents, dimensions, fittings and the catalog page each match comes from (Unicel 2026 Replacement Guide, Pleatco 2023 catalog, Filbur catalog; model-year fitment from cited dealer listings). Unconfirmed rows are flagged as unverified. Affiliate retailer links are disclosed.

## Key pages
- [Home / part-number search](https://myspafilter.com/)
- [Find a filter by size](https://myspafilter.com/size/)
- [Measuring guide](https://myspafilter.com/guide/)
- [Guides index](https://myspafilter.com/guides/)
- [Dataset: all cartridges as an HTML table, with CSV and JSON downloads and a citation snippet](https://myspafilter.com/data/) ([CSV](https://myspafilter.com/data/spa-filters.csv), [JSON](https://myspafilter.com/data/spa-filters.json))
- Model-year lookups: [Hot Spring filter by model and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/hot-spring-filter-by-model-year/), [Caldera filter by model and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/caldera-filter-by-model-year/), [Jacuzzi filter by model and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/jacuzzi-filter-by-model-year/), [Sundance filter by model and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/sundance-filter-by-model-year/), [Bullfrog filter by series and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/bullfrog-filter-by-model-year/), [Master Spas filter by series and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/master-spas-filter-by-model-year/), [Marquis filter by series and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/marquis-filter-by-model-year/), [Dimension One filter by model and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/dimension-one-filter-by-model-year/)
- Brands: [Bullfrog](https://myspafilter.com/bullfrog/), [Cal Spas](https://myspafilter.com/cal-spas/), [Caldera](https://myspafilter.com/caldera/), [Dimension One Spas](https://myspafilter.com/dimension-one-spas/), [Hot Spot](https://myspafilter.com/hot-spot/), [Hot Spring](https://myspafilter.com/hot-spring/), [Intex](https://myspafilter.com/intex/), [Jacuzzi](https://myspafilter.com/jacuzzi/), [Marquis Spas](https://myspafilter.com/marquis-spas/), [Master Spas](https://myspafilter.com/master-spas/), [Softub](https://myspafilter.com/softub/), [Solana](https://myspafilter.com/solana/), [Sundance](https://myspafilter.com/sundance/)

## Holiday 2026
Dates below are the published calendar and carrier dates. The pages do not list a price, a percent off, or a countdown.
- [Black Friday hot tub filters and spa care](https://myspafilter.com/guides/black-friday-hot-tub-filter-and-spa-care/): spare cartridges, chemicals and covers; Black Friday is Friday, November 27, 2026, and Cyber Monday is Monday, November 30, 2026; USPS and UPS send-by dates for Christmas delivery.
- [Gifts for hot tub owners 2026](https://myspafilter.com/guides/gifts-for-hot-tub-owners-2026/)
- [Winter spa care](https://myspafilter.com/guides/winter-spa-care/): cover, filter and water, from Hot Spring, CDC and CPSC. No universal winterizing recipe.
